body:
## Pensieve 0.6.1

### Fixed
- **Working-day hours** set in Settings now show on Today and in the calendar straight away, and on your other devices too.
- **A working day can end after midnight** (say 10:00 to 01:00). Today and the calendar show the hours after midnight, "Plan my day" uses them, and Today counts as today until your day ends. Before this, an end time earlier than the start broke the schedule.
- An event that crosses midnight (23:00–01:00) keeps its full length.

### Download

| Your system | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11 | **Pensieve-Setup-0.6.1.exe** |
| Mac with Apple Silicon | **Pensieve-0.6.1-mac-arm64.zip** |
| Mac with Intel | **Pensieve-0.6.1-mac-x64.zip** |
| Linux (64-bit) | **Pensieve-0.6.1-linux-x86_64.AppImage** or **Pensieve-0.6.1-linux-amd64.deb** |
| Android 8+ (HarmonyOS via 卓易通) | **Pensieve-0.6.1-android.apk** |
| iPhone / iPad (iOS 15+) | **Pensieve-0.6.1-ios-unsigned.ipa** — install with Sideloadly or AltStore ([how](https://photonghost308.github.io/pensieve-app/#ios-install)) |

Already using Pensieve? It updates itself (Settings → General → Updates). Your notes stay as they are.
